Fried green tomatoes.d: Thick slices in buttermilk and cornmeal, fried in bacon drippings. Caper remoulade.
Fried green tomatoes.note: Served hot. Green off the vine, gold out of the skillet.

Honeycomb and biscuits.d: Hot buttermilk biscuits, sweet butter, bee tree honey and a piece of the comb.
Honeycomb and biscuits.note: Idgie fetches it from the bee tree.

Whistle Stop barbecue.d: Pork shoulder roasted slow and pulled, tomato and cider vinegar sauce, slaw, white bread.

Pecan pie.d: Toasted pecans in brown sugar and cane syrup custard, flaky crust.
Pecan pie.note: By the slice, at the counter.

Whistle Stop peach sweet tea.d: Brewed strong with ripe peaches, iced, lemon and mint.
Whistle Stop peach sweet tea.note: Out on the porch, where you can hear the trains.
